title: Databases
description: Databases of your sites. Hostashi stores no database password.
needSite: Create a site first. Every database belongs to a site.

secret.title: Save this password now
secret.text: Hostashi does not store it and cannot show it again. If it is lost, set a new one.
secret.copyFailed: Copying is not possible here. Select the password and copy it by hand.

create.title: New database
create.description: A database belongs to one site.
create.serverHint: A database stays on the server it is created on.
create.name: Database name
create.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
create.withUser: Create a user for it with a generated password

users.title: Users
users.passwordWarning: The old password stops working at once. Update the site's configuration afterwards.
users.deleteWarning: The site can no longer log in with this user.

delete.title: Delete database
delete.hint: The database is deleted with its users. This cannot be undone.

dump.title: Import or export
dump.uploadHint: It is uploaded into the home of site {{site}} and removed after the import; it counts towards the site's disk space meanwhile.
dump.path: File in the home of site {{site}}
dump.pathHintPg: Relative to the home, ending in .dump (pg_dump custom format), .sql or .sql.gz.
dump.pathHint: Relative to the home, ending in .sql or .sql.gz.
dump.neverReplaced: An existing file is never replaced.
dump.uploadFirst: Upload it first, for example over SFTP.
dump.remote: The data goes between this machine and {{server}} with a temporary database user that the panel removes after the job.
dump.importWarnPg: The file runs in {{db}} as one transaction: a failed import changes nothing. A .dump file replaces the tables it contains.
dump.importWarn: The statements in the file run in {{db}}. Import into an empty database: a failed import is not rolled back.

problems.nameChars: Use 1 to {{max}} characters: lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
problems.pathLength: Enter a path of 1 to 255 characters.
problems.endingPg: The file must end in .dump, .sql or .sql.gz.
problems.ending: The file must end in .sql or .sql.gz.
problems.pathParts: Use a path inside the site's home, like backups/shop.sql.gz, without parts that start with a dot or dash.
problems.serverChars: Use 1 to 32 characters: lowercase letters, digits and -, starting with a letter.
problems.serverReserved: This name is reserved for the local server.
problems.host: Enter the server's host name or IP address.
problems.ca: Paste the CA certificate in PEM format.

errors.not_found: This database or user does not exist any more. Reload the page.
errors.agent_timeout: The server did not answer in time. Reload the page to see whether the change was made.

dbServers.title: Database servers
dbServers.description: New databases go to the default server. A database stays on the server it was created on.
dbServers.removed: Removed {{name}}. Its databases were not touched.
dbServers.removeText: The panel forgets the server and its administrator password. Nothing on the server changes.

new.title: Add database server
new.description: A MariaDB, MySQL or PostgreSQL server that the panel creates databases on.
new.name: Name
new.nameHint: How the panel shows the server, for example db1.
new.hostHint: Host name or IP address. Sites use it as DB_HOST.
new.adminHintMariadb: Needs CREATE, DROP, CREATE USER and GRANT OPTION. The panel stores the password encrypted.
new.adminHintPostgresql: A role with CREATEDB and CREATEROLE, not a superuser. The panel stores the password encrypted.
new.verify: TLS with a certificate from a public CA (recommended)
new.verifyCa: TLS with a certificate from my own CA
new.none: No TLS (only in a private network)
new.caHint: PEM format. The panel also checks the server's host name.
new.pgHba: PostgreSQL decides in its pg_hba.conf which hosts may log in. Allow this machine's address there, and only it.
new.noTls: Passwords and data cross the network unencrypted. Use this only inside a private network you trust.

tool.title: Open {{db}} in Adminer
tool.text: Adminer opens in a new tab with a temporary database user for {{db}} only. It runs any SQL on this database, including deleting tables; backups are the safety net.
tool.remote: Adminer connects from this machine to {{server}}, where the panel creates the temporary user. The first session on a server, or one after its address changed, ends the Adminer sessions open at that moment.
tool.blocked: Your browser blocked the new tab.
tool.linkOnce: The link works once, within a minute.
tool.lengthHint: The temporary user and its connections end after this time.

errors.not_found: This database does not exist any more. Reload the page.
errors.forbidden: Your role does not allow opening this database.
errors.site_busy: The site is being created or deleted. Try again in a moment.

action.extendedText: The session now ends at {{time}}. Go back to the Adminer tab; it shows the new time.
action.endedText: The temporary database user is gone and its connections are closed.
action.extendText: The session gets 30 more minutes, up to two hours ahead.
action.endText: Adminer logs out, the temporary database user is removed and its open connections are closed. Queries still running stop.
